definitions.full: H6738. tsel צֵל noun masculine Psa 144:4 shadow ; — ׳צ absolute 2Kin 20:9 +, construct Gen 19:8 +; suffix צִלְךָ Psa 121:5 , צִלּוֺ Ezek 31:6 +, also צִלְלוֺ Job 40:22 , etc.; plural צְלָלִים Song 2:17 ; 4:6 ; construct צִלְלֵי Jer 6:4 ; — 1 shadow on dial 2Kin 20:9-10 , (twice in verse); 20:11 || Isa 38:8 ; צִלְלֶיעָֿ֑רֶב Jer 6:4 , compare Song 2:17 ; 4:6 ; of mountain Judg 9:36 . 2 shadow, shade , as protection (from sun): of branches, Judg 9:15 (in allegory), Hosea 4:13 ; Job 40:22 ; Jonah 4:5-6 , and (in figurative) Hosea 14:8 ; Ezek 17:23 ; 31:6 , 12 , 17 ; Psa 80:11 ; Song 2:3 (of refreshment, delight); of rock Isa 32:2 (simile); ׳צ קֹרָתִי Gen 19:8 shadow of my roof ; of cloud Isa 25:4 and (figurative of ׳י s protection) 4:6 ; 25:4 , so probably 16:3 ; ׳צ כְּנָפֶיךָ shadow of thy wings , figurative of ׳י 's protection Psa 17:8 ; 36:8 ; 57:2 ; 63:8 ; shade , in General, Job 7:2 , figurative of ׳י Psa 121:5 ; hence = protection, defence , of city (wall) Jer 48:45 ; of ׳י Num 14:9 (JE), Psa 91:1 (see also proper name בְּצַלְאֵל ), compare יָדוֺ צֵל Isa 49:2 (covering prophet, under figure of sword), 51:16 (covering people); of human ally 30:2-3 , of king Lam 4:20 ; also of wisdom Eccl 7:12 , money 7:12 . — בְּצִלָּהּ Isa 34:15 apparently reference to קִמּוֺז , but improbable; read perhaps בֵּצֶיהָ her eggs Du Che Hpt (Che Heb Hpt transpose וְדָֽגְרָה וּבָֽקְעָה ). 3 shadow as symbol of transitoriness of life Job 8:9 ; 14:2 ; Psa 144:4 ( עוֺבֵר כְּצֵל ), Eccl 6:12 ; 8:13 ; נָטוּי כְּצֵל of an individual Life near its end Psa 102:12 , So כִּנְטוֺתוֺ כְּצֵל 109:23 ; in simile of emaciated members, כַּצֵּל וִיצֻרַי Job 17:7 . צִלְלֵי צְלָלִים, צִלְלוֺ, see צֶל . above
